name: Article Body / Prose
summary: Article-specific consumer of the canonical Foundations Prose contract with required target-owned semantic content, optional drop cap, authored quote/callout/media extensions, named local overflow, canonical commerce islands, and zero neutral runtime.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Passive non-landmark Article Body boundary; the surrounding target owns article/page semantics.

anatomy.name: proseConsumer
anatomy.description: Explicit consumer of the reusable Foundations Prose contract. Blog CSS does not reimplement the Prose selector.

anatomy.name: pullQuote
anatomy.description: Prominent authored figure containing blockquote and optional attribution caption.

anatomy.name: pullQuoteAttribution
anatomy.description: Optional figcaption outside quoted content; cite identifies a work title rather than a person.

anatomy.name: callout
anatomy.description: Static authored grouped guidance with no implicit alert or status semantics.

anatomy.name: calloutIcon
anatomy.description: Optional decorative or contextually labelled target icon.

anatomy.name: overflow
anatomy.description: L3 marker composed with Foundations prose__overflow for target-named keyboard-scrollable code or genuinely two-dimensional data.

anatomy.name: commerceIsland
anatomy.description: Explicit prose-excluded wrapper containing canonical Product Card and Price without prose restyling.

variants.name: default
variants.description: One passive semantic article-content flow; authored child types are not root variants.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: One readable intrinsic Prose measure; heading ranks and host layout remain contextual.

states.name: default
states.description: Passive resting semantic content composed on canonical Prose.

states.name: dropCap
states.description: Optional visual first-letter treatment that preserves content and collapses in very narrow containers.

states.name: linkFocusVisible
states.description: Canonical Foundations Prose preserves visible native inline-Link focus for Article Body descendants.

states.name: overflowFocusVisible
states.description: The Article Body overflow marker composes Foundations prose__overflow, whose focus-visible state remains visible.

states.name: legacyAliases
states.description: Deprecated one-cycle compatibility aliases for pre-v1 authored content; new source uses Article Body BEM parts.

behavior.name: requiredContent
behavior.description: A non-empty semantic content slot is required. Missing content omits the complete root.

behavior.name: canonicalProseOwnership
behavior.description: Foundations is the sole CSS owner of the reusable Prose selector. L3 adds Article Body BEM extensions without a second Prose implementation.

behavior.name: semanticHierarchy
behavior.description: Targets preserve authored paragraphs, contextual heading ranks, lists, emphasis, quotations, figures/captions, pre/code and table relationships in document order; neither Prose nor L3 parses or infers them.

behavior.name: quotationAttribution
behavior.description: Quoted content remains inside blockquote while attribution remains in figure figcaption; cite identifies a cited work.

behavior.name: staticCallout
behavior.description: Static authored callouts are ordinary grouped content. A target uses canonical Alert only when timing or importance truthfully requires alert/status semantics.

behavior.name: mediaMeaning
behavior.description: Targets own contextual alternatives, captions, loading, sources, crop, focal point and content order; L3 only contains supplied media.

behavior.name: localOverflow
behavior.description: Only code or genuinely two-dimensional data receives a target-named keyboard-scrollable wrapper. The Prose root and page never become horizontal scroll regions.

behavior.name: fullBleedHostBoundary
behavior.description: Genuinely full-bleed media belongs to host layout outside Prose. L3 exposes no full-bleed part, viewport breakout, or page-layout engine.

behavior.name: canonicalCommerceIsland
behavior.description: Commerce inside the article flow uses an explicit Prose exclusion wrapper and canonical Product Card/Price dependencies. L3 does not duplicate product markup, price formatting, or commerce interaction.

behavior.name: legacyMigration
behavior.description: Legacy aliases remain for one pre-v1 migration cycle only. New markup uses Article Body BEM parts, and aliases must be removed before the public v1 contract freezes.

behavior.name: contentTrust
behavior.description: The target owns authoring, trust, sanitization, parsing, localization, heading/link policy, asset delivery, publishing and content completeness; neutral source never injects or rewrites HTML.

behavior.name: passiveRuntime
behavior.description: L3 owns no state, event, observer, request, timer, parser, formatter, sanitizer, highlighter, focus relocation, authored motion, asset, or neutral JavaScript.

properties.name: content
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the complete root when no non-empty semantic content is supplied.
properties.description: Target-owned semantic long-form content including native rich-content nodes, Article Body extensions, named local overflow, and optional prose-excluded canonical islands.

properties.name: dropCap
properties.unsetBehavior: Render semantic content without the Article Body drop-cap class.
properties.description: Applies the accepted visual first-letter treatment to the first direct paragraph without changing content or semantics.

accessibility: Require non-empty semantic content and omit the complete root when absent; the surrounding target owns article/page semantics and contextual heading ranks.
Keep quote attribution outside blockquote, associate it through figure/figcaption, and use cite only for a work title.
Provide contextual image alternatives and captions according to media purpose; captions do not replace informative alt text.
Preserve native list, figure, pre/code and data-table semantics, including captions and header/data relationships.
Use named keyboard-scrollable wrappers only for code or genuinely two-dimensional data; keep Prose and the page free of horizontal overflow.
Keep static authored callouts passive and use canonical Alert only for truthful alert/status content.
Keep canonical commerce components inside prose-excluded wrappers so Prose cannot override their heading, Link, Card, Button, image, or Price contracts.
Preserve visible Link/overflow focus, logical RTL flow, 320/200px content, effective 200 percent text, user text spacing, forced colors, and reduced motion.

web.notes: Article Body composes the Foundations Prose class, Article Body BEM extensions, explicit Prose exclusion, canonical Product Card/Price, named local overflow, and zero neutral runtime.

shopify.notes: The passive article-body snippet maps trusted supplied content or article.content to article-body prose without parsing or rewriting. Sections/templates own sanitization, breakouts, commerce islands, locale, SEO, editor behavior, and canonical child snippets.

react.notes: Preserve the Prose consumer and canonical child-component boundaries without framework state in neutral source.

figma.notes: Needs L3-specific prose hierarchy, drop-cap, quote/callout, media, overflow, and canonical commerce-island artwork; registered nodes remain generic Button shells.
